fix: Require tar-fs ^2.1.4 instead of ^2.0.0 so vulnerable tar-fs (CVE-2025-59343 / GHSA-vj76-c3g6-qr5v, symlink validation bypass) can no longer satisfy prebuild-install's dependency.
credit: @alichtman (PR #214 author; Co-authored-by in the fork commit)
changes: package.json: "tar-fs": "^2.0.0" -> "^2.1.4" (plus trailing newline). No source changes.
Note: a fresh install of upstream 7.1.3 already resolves tar-fs 2.1.5; this change matters when an existing lockfile or dedupe keeps an older tar-fs (e.g. 2.1.1) under prebuild-install.
verification: Project with a lockfile pinning tar-fs@2.1.1 under prebuild-install@7.1.3: npm audit reports GHSA-vj76-c3g6-qr5v; after installing this build, npm upgrades tar-fs to >=2.1.4 and npm audit no longer reports it.

Upstream tape tests: download-test (tar-fs extraction) 35/35, rc 57, util 27, proxy 9, skip 6, log 3 pass. asset-test fails identically with and without this change (pre-existing; Node 20 stream incompatibility in the test harness).
